persona.title: Walk the journey as someone else
persona.intro: {appName} is a demo you can use right now. Pick a person to see the app through their eyes. Everything you do is saved in this browser, and you can switch person at any time to see the other side of a conversation.
persona.loadingBody: Setting up the sample church, its people and the lessons. This happens once.
persona.bootErrorBody: Your browser blocked local storage or something went wrong. You can try again.
persona.volatile: Your browser is not keeping saved data, so changes will be lost when you close this tab.
persona.tryBody: Start as Adaeze, read a lesson and share a reflection with her mentor. Then switch to Grace to reply, and back to Adaeze to see it arrive.
persona.featuredBlurb: New to faith, working through her first pathway. Has a mentor and a group.
persona.resetNote: Everything here is sample data. You can reset it from the menu at any time.

demo.title: Demo controls
demo.intro: These change how the demo behaves so you can see loading, error and offline states.
demo.offlineHelp: Reads and writes will fail until you turn this off.
demo.resetHelp: Deletes your changes and restores the sample church.
demo.resetConfirmBody: Everything you wrote and changed will be removed and the sample data restored.
demo.storageVolatile: Not saved: this browser blocks local storage
